manifest_row.title: Capitalism Will Ruin the Earth By 2050, Scientists Say

screening.main_topic: Whether continued economic growth and capitalism are compatible with decarbonization, and whether a shift toward degrowth could support a clean-energy transition while avoiding dangerous climate change.
screening.climate_relevance: Climate change, greenhouse-gas emissions, the Paris Agreement temperature targets, and transport decarbonization are central to the article’s argument. It also discusses energy and mineral constraints, electric vehicles, and competing views of the research.
screening.reason: The article repeatedly analyzes how economic growth and energy-system choices may affect emissions and global warming, and presents decarbonization as a key reason to consider economic transformation. Climate discourse is sustained and central, not merely incidental.
